description: This file defines the 'DetectiveClient' class within the AWS SDK, specifically for interacting with the Amazon Detective service. It includes method annotations for various API actions, indicating both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: DetectiveClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Detective service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: acceptInvitation
methods.description: Accepts an invitation to join an Amazon Detective behavior graph.

methods.name: batchGetGraphMemberDatasources
methods.description: Retrieves data source information for graph members in batch.

methods.name: batchGetMembershipDatasources
methods.description: Gets data source information for memberships.

methods.name: createGraph
methods.description: Creates a new behavior graph in Amazon Detective.

methods.name: createMembers
methods.description: Creates new members in an Amazon Detective behavior graph.

methods.name: deleteMembers
methods.description: Deletes members from a behavior graph.

methods.name: describeOrganizationConfiguration
methods.description: Provides information about the organization configuration.

methods.name: listInvitations
methods.description: Lists invitations for the detective data graph.

methods.name: rejectInvitation
methods.description: Rejects an invitation to join a behavior graph.

methods.name: updateInvestigationState
methods.description: Updates the state of an investigation.
